in_marathi.name: Gajpati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajpati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gajpati is a name derived from Sanskrit language, where 'Gaja' means elephant and 'Patni' means Lord or Master. This name is associated with power, strength, and leadership, symbolizing the ruler or protector of elephants.
